name: Pereput'e
source:
In the late hours, a slave trader's wagon rides through the crooked trees of the gloomy forest. Asya has no idea where or why she is being taken. How will the girl's fate change tonight? Will she be able to stay alive in such a strange world, where everything is not what it seems?

[translated from [url=https://sirandriy.itch.io/crossroads]itch.io[/url]]
